svg.title: Sampling distributions of two estimators of a uniform upper endpoint
svg.desc: Two panels on a shared horizontal scale for a Uniform(0, 1) sample of size ten. The upper panel shows the nearly symmetric density of two times the sample mean, standard deviation 0.183. The lower panel shows the sharply left-skewed density of eleven tenths of the sample maximum, standard deviation 0.091, with a hard edge at 1.1.
svg.text: Two unbiased estimators of theta: Uniform(0, theta), n = 10, theta = 1
the horizontal scale is the same in both panels, and both densities are exact
mass falls on both sides of theta
Both estimators average to theta. The lower one concentrates twice as tightly, so its mean squared error is
